author: marcio79
quote: Nintendo’s purest work of art. A magnificent game for those who experienced the original on the Nintendo 64. I hope they make more.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: marcio79
quote: This is not GTA!!! There’s a lack of genuine freedom, killer cats, and bugs everywhere. Ridiculous NPCs, restrictions on stealing cars, and invincible NPCs—they’ve managed to ruin the franchise. And I haven’t even mentioned playing in slow motion at a staggering 30 FPS. I hope the PC community "fixes" the game. Not to mention that you’re basically a slave to your female companion, lol.
